title: InputMap not being correctly reloaded after project.godot changes
body:
### Tested versions

Originally happened in 4.5.1-stable when making my game.

Also tested in 4.6-beta 2

### System information

Linux (Fedora 43) - dont think its relevant

### Issue description

When modifying the `project.godot` file to add new input actions outside of the environment and reloading the project from disk when prompted, the new input actions will be recognized by the game and the engine correctly, but not shown in the "InputMap" list in the project settings.

After a full reload of the project (restarting the engine), they appear correctly.

I assume this happens because that UI is not reloaded when reloading the project from disk via the prompt.

Originally happened to me when switching git branches, but happens whenever you modify the plaintext `project.godot`

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/dc7545af-c004-4e41-a01d-32be7037aae9

### Steps to reproduce

1. Modify `project.godot` via a text editor
2. Add new input actions to the `project.godot` file
3. Go back to the Godot window
4. When prompted by the engine, hit reload from disk
5. Go to the InputMap in project settings
6. New actions are missing from the list, even though they exist

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Requires modifying the files so a MRP would be just the default template where I would tell you to manually modify `project.godot`
